question:
Select the most appropriate one-word substitution for the given words.

Special words and phrases used by particular groups of people, especially in their work
solution:
The correct answer is option 4) i.e. 'Jargon'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let us look into the meaning of the words in the options - 
 
 
• Dialogue - a conversation between two or more people as a feature of a book, play, or film. (वार्ता)
 
• Elocution - the skill of clear and expressive speech, especially of distinct pronunciation and articulation. (वाग्मिता)
 
• Conversation - a talk, especially an informal one, between two or more people, in which news and ideas are exchanged. (बातचीत)
 
• Jargon - special words or expressions used by a profession or group that are difficult for others to understand. (शब्दजाल)
 
 
 
• From the above meanings it is clear that jargon is the best word to substitute the given group of words. 
 
• Hence, option 4 is the correct answer.
